Here, you are responsible for curing, pressing, and brining high-quality specialty cheeses, as well as making our dairy products, such as yogurt and quark. You will be taught the cheesemaking process by our best cheesemakers. The duties of a curder involve ensuring the curd is prepared for pressing into cheese (this is done by hand). You ensure the cheeses are placed in the cheese vats and that they are turned. Additionally, you assist with cleaning equipment and machinery and are responsible for a hygienic work environment.

• You are proactive, quality-conscious, and have an independent work attitude
